meta.title: Devlog: August 30, 2026 - September 6, 2026
meta.description: updates to due or die's onboarding and accountability controls, alongside a clearer privacy policy for analytics and cancellation feedback.

bullets.text: reworked onboarding around configurable accountability options for procrastination, distraction, structure, work time, and forgetfulness.
continued work on configurable reminders, lock now prompts, routine suggestions, and daily work-time lockouts.
made the accountability summary shorter and clearer, with more direct defaults for working time.

summary.text: i spent this week making the app's accountability setup feel more like a useful starting point and less like a questionnaire. it's still in progress, but the pieces are starting to connect without making every new task feel like paperwork.

bullets.text: released an updated privacy policy covering limited product analytics and cancellation feedback.
clarified that task titles, display names, selfies, selected distractions, session replay, and location enrichment are not included in analytics.

summary.text: i also updated the privacy policy to be more direct about the limited information used to improve the app. privacy copy is not glamorous, but it should at least be clear.
